blocks.title: Assuring a common level of competency.
blocks.intro: KLL’s service provider assessment schemes help assure the public of competence and safety.

elements.html: We independently assess service providers working within the electricity, gas, and water sectors. By operating these assessment schemes, we help assure a common level of competency through technical assessments.

Business owners and home owners can find service providers in the areas of electricity, gas and water. 

Service providers can also find information about how to get accredited.
